text:
rachel: mid-demo meltdownrouter decided to do dramatic reboots. video froze, then came back as a tiny rectangle. :joy:

omar: ugh been there. did you get any speed numbers?

rachel: quick run: `ping -c4 8.8.8.8` showed packet loss intermittently. weird spikes.

sylvie: timeline? ISPs love to deny unless you have timestamps. run something like: `while sleep 15; do date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S; ping -c1 1.1.1.1; done >> ~/home-net.log`

rachel: doing that now. also unplugged and reseated the coax because drama.

omar: if you have a coax join near the modem, check the F-connector tightness. loose ones caused me grief.

it-bot: [automated] Reminder: attach `~/home-net.log` and a screenshot of the meeting failure if filing an IT ticket. KB: https://intra.redwood/it/connectivity

sylvie: also, if you use a USB-C -> ethernet dongle, it's usually more stable than wifi for demos.

rachel: only adapter I have is at office. tempted to sprint and grab it like an Olympic event.

omar: also vote: new slack channel #wfh-tilted-desks for all the furniture relocation stories? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sylvie: yes. curated chaos.

rachel: update: `home-net.log` shows 3x packet loss spikes in the last 10m. filing ticket. thanks for the checklists.

omar: good luck. post the victory selfie if you tame the router.

rachel: will do. if not, expect a heroic tale of furniture moving and coffee spills. :coffee:
